body: I freeze where I am, my heart pounding in my chest like thunderous drums. The silence crackles around me, punctuated only by the distant hum of bees. My eyes dart left and right, searching for an escape route without looking back into those metallic eyes. The air seems thick with unseen dangers, but I know staying still could be worse than running.
